scope.policy: Screenshots are behavioral/layout references only; personal names, avatars, memberships, connection accounts and invite URLs are not copied into product data.
scope.completion_rule: Every non-excluded item must be accepted with recorded verification evidence. Existing means source foundations observed, not acceptance complete.
scope.production_deployment: The active goal authorizes GitHub commit, push, conflict resolution and merge, followed by a built and published Windows update, after the complete implementation and acceptance gates pass.

status_definitions.existing: Relevant baseline or partial foundations exist; this does not assert the full behavior is implemented, and acceptance remains outstanding.
status_definitions.missing: Required behavior or complete integration has not been established.
status_definitions.implemented_unverified: Implementation added, but full acceptance evidence is not yet recorded.
status_definitions.accepted: Acceptance scenario passed with recorded evidence artifact.
status_definitions.excluded: Explicit scope exclusion with a reason; no simulated success.

items.title: Delete account
remaining_implementation: User answered on 2026-10-23: anonymize the deleted identity and preserve shared conversation history for other participants. Do not delete shared history or reuse administrative owned-server deletion as a self-service policy. Application removal now has owner/session/credential-bound production wiring, retired-token guards, registration-race and recurring gateway validation, strict API consent, owned-only runtime revocation and a TR/EN management panel (p2-application-removal-foundation-2026-10-23.json; p2-application-removal-ui-2026-10-23.json). Recipient-accepted application ownership handoff now has a seven-day request, recipient-only resolution, atomic owner change, old-credential revocation and one-time replacement credential foundation (p8-application-transfer-foundation-2026-10-23.json); live two-client and installed-Windows acceptance remains open.

Deletion route/auth option, TR/EN consent form, owner preflight and durable cleanup are wired. Server handoff has credential/session-bound service/route, transactional owner-role/audit snapshots, recipient/on-confirm forms and superseding member refresh. Browser-button handoff/deletion preserved the transferred server and plaintext history; independent API login confirmed old-owner admin denial and anonymized history (p2-server-handoff-ui-2026-10-23.json). Revision guards now supersede in-flight same-process server/channel permission reads, including mixed bulk snapshots, with bounded fail-closed retries (p2-permission-inflight-2026-10-23.json). Finish distributed-instance behavior, recipient-accepted application handoff, browser/independent encrypted-client/attachment/SFU/Windows application-removal and retention acceptance.
